gloss: full; a cup of; a lot

definitions.explanation: A serving of liquid in a cup or glass.

examples.japanese: ⟦{電車|でんしゃ}→電車：00522_densha⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{一杯|いっぱい}⟦だった→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: The train was full of people.

examples.japanese: ⟦お{腹|なか}→お腹：00805_onaka⟧{一杯|いっぱい}⟦{食|た}べた→食べる：00396_taberu⟧。
examples.english: I ate until I was full.

examples.japanese: ⟦{駐車場|ちゅうしゃじょう}→駐車場：01667_chuushajou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{一杯|いっぱい}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{車|くるま}→車：00516_kuruma⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{止|と}められなかった→止める：00678_tomeru⟧。
examples.english: The parking lot was full and I couldn't park.

examples.japanese: ⟦ビール→ビール：01015_biiru⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{一杯|いっぱい}⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
⟦コーヒー→コーヒー：00789_koohii⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{一杯|いっぱい}⟦{飲|の}んだ→飲む：00322_nomu⟧。
examples.english: I had a cup of coffee.

examples.japanese: ⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{後|あと}→後：09580_ato⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{一杯|いっぱい}⟦いかが→いかが：02846_ikaga⟧⟦です→だ：09496_da⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
examples.english: How about a drink after work?

examples.japanese: ⟦{宿題|しゅくだい}→宿題：00812_shukudai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{一杯|いっぱい}⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: I have a lot of homework.

examples.japanese: ⟦{花|はな}→花：00523_hana⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{一杯|いっぱい}⟦{咲|さ}いている→咲く：08150_saku⟧。
⟦{今日|きょう}→今日：00496_kyou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦やる→やる：02980_yaru⟧⟦こと→こと：01164_koto⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{一杯|いっぱい}⟦あって→ある：00006_aru⟧、⟦{休|やす}む→休む：00606_yasumu⟧⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧。
examples.english: I have so much to do today that I don't have time to rest.

notes:
{一杯|いっぱい} has multiple meanings.

1. FULL:
- お{腹|なか}{一杯|いっぱい}: stomach is full
- {人|ひと}で{一杯|いっぱい}: full of people

2. ONE CUP/GLASS:
- コーヒー{一杯|いっぱい}: one cup of coffee
- {一杯|いっぱい}いかが？: How about a drink?

3. A LOT:
- {一杯|いっぱい}ある: there's a lot
- {一杯|いっぱい}{食|た}べる: to eat a lot
